title: Playboy: America's Hottest Strip Clubs
overview: Get ready as Playboy takes you on a no-holds-barred tour of the best and hottest strip clubs in North America for wild, untamed action. You'll see Lexus, Nicole Sherridan, and some of the most incredible bodies on the planet as Playboy's special access takes you on stage and back stage with the sexiest and most exotic dancers. Catch every revealing moment from Hollywood, Tampa, Las Vegas, Boston and more as we show you the best of the best!
